日文.首段: 唐湊線（とそせん）は、鹿児島県鹿児島市中央町の鹿児島中央駅前停留場から鹿児島市鴨池二丁目の郡元停留場までを結ぶ鹿児島市交通局（鹿児島市電）の軌道路線である。

路線距離（営業キロ）：2.7 km
軌間：1435mm
停留場数：10（起終点含む）

章节.歴史:

1957年（昭和32年）3月29日 - 唐湊 - 大学通（現・工学部前）間が開業。唐湊停留場を神田停留場へ改称。
1959年（昭和34年）12月20日 - 工学部前 - 郡元間が開業し全通。
1985年（昭和34年）4月15日 - 専売公社前停留場をたばこ産業前停留場に改称。
2004年（平成16年）3月13日 - 西鹿児島駅前停留場を鹿児島中央駅前停留場に改称。
2015年（平成27年）5月1日 - たばこ産業前停留場を市立病院前停留場に、神田停留場を神田（交通局前）停留場に改称。

英文.首段: The Toso Line (唐湊線) is a tram line of the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau (Kagoshima City Tram), running from Kagoshima-Chūō-Ekimae Station in Chūō-chō, Kagoshima, to Kōrimoto Station in Kamoike 2-chōme, Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture.

章节.Line data: Line length: 2.7 km; track gauge: 1,435 mm; stations: 10 (including both termini); double-tracked over the entire line; electrified over the entire line (600 V DC).
章节.Service patterns: Route 2 (Kagoshima-Ekimae – Kagoshima-Chūō-Ekimae – Kōrimoto) runs over the whole Toso Line at six-minute intervals.
章节.History:
October 1, 1950 (Shōwa 25): the section between Nishi-Kagoshima-Ekimae and Nakasudō opens.
June 1, 1952 (Shōwa 27): the section between Nakasudō and Toso opens.
March 29, 1957 (Shōwa 32): the section between Toso and Daigaku-dōri (present-day Kōgakubū-mae) opens; Toso Station is renamed Kanda Station.
December 20, 1959 (Shōwa 34): the section between Kōgakubū-mae and Kōrimoto opens, completing the line.
April 15, 1985 (Shōwa 60): Senbaikōmae Station is renamed Tabako-Sangyō-mae Station.
March 13, 2004 (Heisei 16): Nishi-Kagoshima-Ekimae Station is renamed Kagoshima-Chūō-Ekimae Station.
May 1, 2015 (Heisei 27): Tabako-Sangyō-mae Station is renamed Shiritsu-Byōin-mae Station, and Kanda Station is renamed Kanda (Kōtsūkyoku-mae) Station.

章节.Connections:
Kagoshima-Chūō-Ekimae Station: through services on the Kagoshima City Tram Second Section, and interchange with the Kyūshū Shinkansen, Kagoshima Main Line, Nippō Main Line and Ibusuki-Makurazaki Line at Kagoshima-Chūō Station.
Kōrimoto Station: interchange with the Taniyama Line.

英文.首段: Chūgun Station (中郡駅) is a railway station on the JR East Yonesaka Line located in Ōaza-Tokida, Kawanishi, Higashiokitama District, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.

章节.History:
September 28, 1926 (Taishō 15): opens with the opening of the Yonesaka Line between Yonezawa and Imaizumi.
June 10, 1961 (Shōwa 36): freight handling discontinued.
March 20, 1982 (Shōwa 57): baggage handling discontinued; the station becomes unstaffed.
April 1, 1987 (Shōwa 62): following the privatization of JNR, the station comes under the control of JR East.
March 17, 2001 (Heisei 13): the present station building is completed.
章节.Station layout: An at-grade station with one side platform serving a single track. It is an unstaffed station managed by Yonezawa Station.
章节.Usage: In fiscal 2004, the station was used by an average of 41 boarding passengers daily.
章节.Rapid Benibana / Local: Narushima Station — Chūgun Station — Uzen-Komatsu Station.
章节.Railway stations in Yamagata Prefecture: Chūgun Station is one of the railway stations in Yamagata Prefecture, Japan.

December 20, 1959 (Shōwa 34): established by the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau.

Station layout
Two opposed side platforms, one track each, at street level. Passengers can cross between the two platforms at any time unless a tram is passing through.
Wheelchair and motorized-wheelchair use is not permitted on either platform because the platform width does not meet the required standard.
The stop is unstaffed and no tickets are sold.
Platforms:
Route 2 — for Kōrimoto
Route 2 — for Kagoshima-Chūō-Ekimae, Tenmonkan and Kagoshima-Ekimae.

Surrounding area
Kagoshima Junshin Girls’ Gakuen (actually located on a hill above the stop).

Route 2
Kōgakubū-mae Station — Junshin-Gakuen-mae Station — Chūgun Station.

Railway stations in Kagoshima City
Junshin-Gakuen-mae Station is one of the tram stops in Kagoshima City, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.

章节目录: ゆんしんかくえんまえ

日文.首段: 郡元駅（こおりもとえき）は、鹿児島県鹿児島市唐湊四丁目にある、九州旅客鉄道（JR九州）指宿枕崎線の駅である。

章节.歴史:
1986年（昭和61年）12月1日：日本国有鉄道の駅として開業。駅員無配置駅。
 1987年（昭和62年）4月1日：国鉄分割民営化に伴い、九州旅客鉄道（JR九州）の駅となる。
 1990年（平成2年）3月：ダイヤ改正に合わせ、ホーム有効長を90mから112mに延伸。
 2012年（平成24年）12月1日：ICカード「SUGOCA」の利用が可能となる。
 2020年（令和2年）5月30日：駅遠隔案内システム（Smart Support Station）「ANSWER」の導入に伴い無人化。
章节.駅構造:
単式ホーム1面1線を持つ地上駅。かつては有人駅であったが、2020年5月30日より駅遠隔案内システム（Smart Support Station）「ANSWER」の導入に伴い再度無人化された。

IC乗車カード「SUGOCA」の利用が可能で（相互利用可能ICカードはSUGOCAの項を参照）、簡易SUGOCA改札機が設置されている。SUGOCAの販売は行なっていない。

簡易自動券売機（ICカード非対応）、ICカードチャージ機が設置されている。

のりば
章节.利用状況: 2020年（令和2年）度の1日平均の乗車人員は889人である。
章节.駅周辺:
周辺は「中郡」（なかごおり）と呼ばれ、鹿児島大学や附属小学校、附属中学校、専門学校等が集まる文教エリアである。また鹿児島中央駅と当駅の間に鹿児島車両センターがあることにより当駅まで引込線があり、付近には食品やリネン関係の工場や倉庫等もある。

背後の丘陵部にある地区は、傾斜地にもかかわらず古くから住宅が建ち並び市街地化した。坂道が多い庶民的な住宅地である。
章节.備考: 鹿児島市電の郡元電停とは直線距離で700ｍ程離れている。郡元地区は広いエリアを持っており、当駅（JR郡元）は唐湊地区、市電電停は港湾エリアに隣接した鴨池地区であり、当駅最寄りの電停は純心学園前電停である。

英文.首段: Kōrimoto Station (郡元駅) is a railway station on the JR Kyushu Ibusuki-Makurazaki Line located in Toso 4-chōme, Kagoshima, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.

章节.History:
December 1, 1986 (Shōwa 61): opens as a JNR station, unstaffed.
April 1, 1987 (Shōwa 62): following the privatization of JNR, the station comes under the control of JR Kyushu.
March 1990 (Heisei 2): platform effective length is extended from 90 m to 112 m to match the timetable revision.
December 1, 2012 (Heisei 24): IC card "SUGOCA" becomes usable.
May 30, 2020 (Reiwa 2): remote station guidance is introduced.
章节.Station layout:
An at-grade station with one side platform serving a single track. It was formerly staffed, but from May 30, 2020 it became unstaffed again following the introduction of the remote guidance system (Smart Support Station) "ANSWER".
The IC card "SUGOCA" is usable (see the SUGOCA article for mutually compatible cards), and a simple SUGOCA gate reader is installed; SUGOCA cards are not sold at the station. A simple automatic ticket vending machine (not IC-compatible) is also provided.
章节.Usage: In fiscal 2020 (Reiwa 2), the average daily boarding passengers numbered 889.
章节.Surrounding area:
The surrounding district is known as "Nakagōri" and is an education area clustered with Kagoshima University and its attached elementary and junior high schools, and various vocational schools. The Kagoshima Rolling Stock Center lies between Kagoshima-Chūō Station and this station, giving rise to a siding that reaches this station; factories and warehouses related to food and linen are also found nearby.
The hilly area behind the station has long been built up with houses on the slopes, forming a residential area of many slopes and a everyday atmosphere.
章节.Notes: The station is about 700 m in a straight line from the Kōrimoto tram stop on the Kagoshima City Tram. The Kōrimoto district covers a wide area; this JR station lies in the Toso district, while the tram stop is in the Kamoike district next to the port area. The tram stop nearest to this station is Junshin-Gakuen-mae.
章节.Rapid Nanohana / Local: Kagoshima-Chūō Station — Kōrimoto Station — Minami-Kagoshima Station.
章节.Railway stations in Kagoshima City: Kōrimoto Station is one of the railway stations in Kagoshima City, Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan.
